title: Roblox Agrees to Child Safety Changes After eSafety Testing
body: The eSafety Commissioner has announced that Roblox has agreed to implement child safety improvements following transparency testing. The changes will enhance protections for young users on the gaming platform. Australian sporting clubs using Roblox for community engagement should review the updated safety features.

title: Eltham Wildcats Officials Face Charges Over Sex Offender Employment
body: Police have launched a probe into Eltham Wildcats basketball club officials who face potential jail time and fines over the employment of a registered sex offender. The case highlights the critical importance of proper Working With Children Check compliance in Victorian sporting clubs. All Victorian clubs should review their screening and verification processes immediately.

title: Record Fines Issued in NSW Child Safety Crackdown
body: New South Wales authorities have issued record fines as part of an intensified child safety compliance crackdown. The enforcement action targets organisations failing to meet child safe standards requirements. NSW sporting clubs should ensure all child safety policies and procedures are current and fully implemented.
